test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

Based on the above, how is K related to O if ‘K – L × M – N + O’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 **A is**

 +

 to B
 
 

**Given: **K – L × M – N + O

K – L → K is the brother of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0422794552116103825abce8cdd77a1f3ace086b90aa13378084101706e8e9b8.png] 

L × M → L is the mother of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1608e39fc8509039c3c3bd08c276d791576c902a04d599503c9655c87b024df.png] 

M – N → M is the brother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6a659d8acc76d6c8f63642d348d8ca84e0e8d3d66609047bbb4523285e9e38a.png] 

 

N + O → N is the daughter of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/198c1dd39759deed19197d9296852a8e811e8f5e3e9976442b1cfdd3d936d971.png] 

Here, K is the brother-in-law or wife's brother of O.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
